outcomes.name: Understanding of the sponsorship and governance approach has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The sponsorship and governance approach is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Strategic Direction & Leadership is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the sponsorship and governance approach.
Identify why the sponsorship and governance approach hasn't landed consistently for Strategic Direction & Leadership in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the sponsorship and governance approach for Strategic Direction & Leadership.
Confirm the sponsorship and governance approach for Strategic Direction & Leadership is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Strategic Direction & Leadership regularly to ensure the sponsorship and governance approach stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how People Experience & Culture has been affected by inconsistent sponsorship and governance approach since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific People Experience & Culture-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen People Experience & Culture in teams/sites where the sponsorship and governance approach is weakest.
Confirm People Experience & Culture has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on People Experience & Culture so gaps in the sponsorship and governance approach are caught early in future.
Survey teams/sites to understand how Planning & Risk has been affected by inconsistent sponsorship and governance approach since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific Planning & Risk-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen Planning & Risk in teams/sites where the sponsorship and governance approach is weakest.
Confirm Planning & Risk has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on Planning & Risk so gaps in the sponsorship and governance approach are caught early in future.
